sources.note: Main Netsmart homepage. Describes CareFabric platform, lists all products (myAvatar, myEvolv, myUnity, TheraOffice, GEHRIMED, myInsight), Bells AI, and overall company positioning as community-based care technology provider.

myAvatar product page. Details behavioral health EHR features: clinical documentation, scheduling, closed-loop medication management, billing (remittance processing, denial management, Medicare pharmacy billing), compliance monitoring, role-based dashboards, tablet workflows.
ONC certification page listing all certified products. Confirms myAvatar Certified Edition with Real World Testing plans 2022-2025. Lists EHI All Data Export availability and API pricing information.
Inpatient psychiatric facilities page. Details closed-loop medication management, CPOE for labs/diet/seclusion/restraint, HIPAA and 42 CFR Part 2 compliance, inventory management and accounting.

Integrated care page. Describes primary care documentation within myAvatar, specialty content for pediatrics/women's health, AI-powered documentation, FQHC billing, UDS/PCMH/MIPS reporting, CCBHC support, dental EHR integration.

Interoperability page. Details QHIN designation, CareConnect Integration Engine (HL7/FHIR/Direct), CareConnect Inbox, Carequality connectivity (4,200+ hospitals, 600,000+ providers), 6.5B+ transactions since 2018.

Consumer engagement page. Describes myHealthPointe portal features: appointment scheduling, lab results viewing, medication refill requests, secure messaging, assessments, electronic consents, telehealth launch.
myHealthPointe portal product page (found via search, referenced for portal feature details).

EMRSystems review. Confirms 20+ modules, lists features (patient records, scheduling, progress notes, treatment plans, order entry, pharmacy, billing, financial reporting, e-prescribing, document management). Notes first behavioral health EHR to earn Complete EHR Ambulatory and Complete EMR Inpatient from Drummond. Reports 18,000+ customers, on-premise or cloud deployment.

Capterra reviews page (403 blocked on fetch). Search results indicated mixed reviews: users appreciate centralized clinical view and customizable documentation, complaints about speed and system stability.
Software Advice profile (403 blocked on fetch). Search results confirmed feature list and review availability.
Software Finder profile. Referenced in search results for feature confirmation.
InterSystems case study about Netsmart. Confirms position as leading behavioral health EHR.
Wikipedia article (403 blocked on fetch). Search snippet provided company history: founded 1992, technology origins 1968, behavioral health/human services/post-acute care focus, PE ownership history.
Reuters/Yahoo Finance article (Jan 2024) on GI Partners and TA Associates exploring sale of Netsmart at $5B+ valuation.
PE Hub article (Dec 2025) reporting renewed sale process launch in early 2026, ~$250M EBITDA.
GI Partners portfolio page for Netsmart. Confirms ownership structure.
Datavant integration page confirming myAvatar EHR integration capabilities.
Yolo County myAvatar resources page. Confirms county government use of myAvatar for behavioral health services.
